Every post here comes from the same fixed test bench, and every number in one
was measured rather than quoted: prompt-processing and decode speed as curves
rather than single figures, time-to-first-token from the client's side, the
largest context that both loads *and* completes a request, peak VRAM, and power
draw integrated into energy per token.

The tooling sweeps each runtime's tuning parameters to their limits, so the
comparison is never "defaults versus defaults" — it is what the hardware can
really do once someone has tried.
